title: FLA->SWF static text: title not horizontally centered (x_offset dropped)
description: Surfaced by Ruffle render of published golden.fla vs reference golden.swf (apps/desktop/e2e/golden-fla-oracle.spec.ts; GOLDEN_REF_SWF env renders the reference). The 'Test Game' title DefineText renders LEFT-aligned; golden renders it CENTERED. Cause: golden's title TextRecord bakes x_offset=3640 twips (centres glyphs in the box; bounds x=3651..7713), but we emit x_offset=0 (bounds x=0..4139) so text sits at the left edge. The authored text-box horizontal offset/alignment is dropped on import or zeroed on encode. Files: packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts (case 'text' ~931/1083, align/registrationX), packages/swf/src/text.ts (DefineText encode). NOTE/PIVOT: glyph 'garbling' (overlapping/stray letters) is a FONT-ENVIRONMENT artifact, NOT a parity bug — golden.fla was authored on Windows 7 / Flash 8 with system Arial; we publish on macOS and substitute a generated font, so glyph shapes/advances differ. Exact glyph parity is out of scope (accepted pivot). Only the x_offset centering is actionable here. Acceptance: published title renders horizontally centered like golden (position parity), font glyph differences accepted.
